gentPassages.title: Vigilon 2015 commissioning instructions
gentPassages.text: The Zone Test mode is applicable for EN VIGILON 4/6-loop panel, VIGILON Compact panel and VIGILON Compact VA panel only and is used when testing devices in a zone. It allows the engineer to test zones without having to return to the panel to silence alarms and reset the system.

gentPassages.title: Vigilon 2009 operating instructions
gentPassages.text: The weekly fire test can be carried out at a manual call point without breaking the call point glass. Insert the test key into the key hole located on the bottom-centre front face of the call point and turn the key one quarter of a turn clockwise.

network: Cold runtime load from local static server with model data already cached; later calls in each run had browser networking disabled. Service workers were blocked to isolate current app files, so no offline startup claim follows from these benchmarks.
